title: Can I BEAT Myself as a Chess Bot?
summary: Tony plays the 'Tony' bot on iwantcheckmate.com, programmed with parameters to imitate his own play (London System, bishop moves he'd make, ladder-mate obsession). The site has an iwantcheckmate-themed board ('battleground'), with no ads/accounts. Game 1 mirrors London vs London and Tony concedes; game 2 he wins with a ladder mate.
rules: Normal chess vs the Tony bot (site rating 2100).
Bot imitates Tony: plays London System as White / symmetrical London ideas, ladder-mate tendencies.
